scientificModel.reason: This project publishes archival journalism and supports editorial review. It is not a scientific model or a confirmatory experiment.

evidenceBoundary: Counts, source-link reachability, tests and deployment receipts establish bounded engineering evidence. They do not establish factual correctness, original reporting, image rights, human editorial approval or completed operational acceptance. A reader record marked published is a registry state, not certification. The 248 other drafts are not certified finished articles.

acceptanceGates.requiredEvidence: Named human editor acceptance; record-by-record material-claim and independent-source review; accurate authorship, fairness and privacy review; explicit launch selection and approval.
Documented licence or permission for every selected media asset, resolution of conflicting provenance and explicit exclusion of uncleared assets.
Named incident and intake operator acceptance, monitored contact path and controlled acknowledgement, triage, escalation and closure exercise.
Accountable retention/deletion owner, verified handling practice and explicit acceptance of capture-only newsletter operation before launch.
Provider-supported database backup/restore and application rollback rehearsal with the accepted incident owner; an empty-data snapshot alone is insufficient.
Representative physical-device and screen-reader review with recorded findings and repairs; automated viewport checks alone are insufficient.
Representative live slow-network measurements and field-performance review when sufficient real traffic exists; distinguish lab measurements from field data.
Explicit owner authorization to change the owner-private audience after the launch gates have been reviewed.
